extension.description: Jira in VS Code: your issues, issue card, attachments, status changes, time logging with Tempo, epics and releases
capabilities.untrusted: Jiraffe talks to Jira with your token and saves attachments to the workspace folder, so it only works in trusted folders.
command.setMode: Jiraffe: List Mode (Assigned to Me / Project / JQL)
command.search: Jiraffe: Search by Text or Key
command.ungroupIssues: Jiraffe: Show Issues as a Flat List
welcome.noInstances:
No Jira instances for this workspace.
[Add Instance](command:jiraffe.addInstance)
[Choose from Connected](command:jiraffe.scopeInstances)
config.instances: Which instances to show in this workspace: instance id or URL (`https://jira.example.com`). Unset or empty means all connected instances. Handy in the project folder's `.vscode/settings.json`; to pick with the mouse, use the **Jiraffe: Workspace Instances** command. Connections and tokens are shared across all windows.
config.maxResults: How many issues to load per request (and per "Load More" click).
config.attachmentsDir: Where to save attachments: a path relative to the first workspace folder (inside it); an issue's attachments go to a <KEY> subfolder. An absolute path is accepted only from user settings. With no folder open, a temporary directory is used (<tmp>/jiraffe, cleaned after a week).
config.maxImageMb: Maximum size (MB) of an image the card downloads for preview and for showing in the description. Larger images can only be downloaded via "Download".
config.workdayHours: Workday length in hours: the denominator of the "Today 3h 15m / 8h" summary in the Tempo view and the status bar.
